data.title: Enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid) from Amtsgericht Musterwedding
data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musterwedding (Berlin-Brandenburg central dunning court) issued an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid) against you on behalf of Exempel Online-Akademie UG, because no objection (Widerspruch) was filed against the earlier payment order (Mahnbescheid) of 12 October 2026. The total claimed is €789.45, and the order was delivered to you on 23 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is a court title that allows the claimant to have a bailiff enforce payment of €789.45 against you. It was issued automatically because no objection was made to the earlier payment order, so the underlying claim was never checked by a judge. You can still object (Einspruch) to this enforcement order itself, within the short Notfrist shown by the app, counted from the delivery date. If you do nothing by then, the order becomes final (rechtskräftig) and enforceable, meaning a bailiff could seize money or belongings. Because the deadline is short and the consequences serious, consider contacting a lawyer or a consumer advice centre quickly.

items.action: Send a written objection (Einspruch) to the Amtsgericht Musterwedding if you disagree with the claim.
items.consequence: The enforcement order becomes final and legally binding (rechtskräftig) and the claimant can enforce it, e.g. through a bailiff.

items.action: Settle the total amount of €789.45 with the claimant (Exempel Online-Akademie UG), or seek legal advice before this is enforced.
items.consequence: The claimant is entitled to have the amount enforced, for example by a court bailiff, since execution from this title is now permitted.
